Website design

Website design for small businesses in Denton and DFW

A custom site built around how your business actually works, structured so customers and search engines both understand what you do and where you do it.

What this is

I design and build custom websites for small businesses in Denton, Denton County, and the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex. Every site is built for one specific business rather than assembled from a template, and every project starts with a working demo you can click through before you pay anything.

That last part is the thing worth reading twice. You are not approving a picture of a website. You get a real site, at a real address, that you can open on your phone and show to someone, and you decide from there.

Services

What I build

Everything on this side of the work, grouped by what you are trying to do.

01

New builds

  • 01

    Ecommerce website design→

    Online stores for local businesses that sell products. Clear product pages, simple checkout, and setup for local pickup or shipping.

  • 02

    Landing page design→

    A single focused page built for one goal, like booking a call or requesting a quote. Useful for ads, promotions, or a service you want more of.

  • 03

    Service area page design→

    A page for each town you serve, with real local detail, so customers in those areas and Google can both see that you work there.

02

Rebuilds and moves

  • 01

    Website redesign→

    Turn a dated or slow site into a modern one without losing the rankings you already have. Includes redirect mapping, rewritten content, and a mobile-first layout.

  • 02

    Website migration→

    Move your site to a new platform or host without breaking pages or losing search traffic. Includes redirect mapping and a check after the move.

03

Conversion

  • 01

    Conversion rate optimization→

    Changes that turn more of the visitors you already have into leads: clearer calls to action, better forms, trust signals, and tested layouts.

  • 02

    UX/UI design→

    Layout and navigation tactically planned to keep your leads hooked on the page, so visitors find what they need and get in touch faster.

04

Copy and booking

  • 01

    Website copywriting→

    Website copy that explains what you do, who you help, and why someone should pick you. Written in your voice, for your customers.

  • 02

    Online booking setup→

    Let customers book a call, a consult, or a job straight from your site. Connects to your calendar so you stop trading voicemails just to find a time that works.

05

Upkeep

  • 01

    Website speed optimization→

    Fix the heavy images, bloated code, and slow hosting that keep pages from loading. Faster pages hold visitors and support better rankings.

  • 02

    Website Maintenance→

    Ongoing upkeep to keep your site running the way it did on launch day. Covers analytics, speed, content updates, hosting, and catching issues before they cost you visitors. Pairs with SEO and GBP work so the site keeps performing without added effort on your end.

How a build runs

You book a free consult and tell me about the business. I design and build a working version before you pay for anything. If it is not what you wanted you walk away, and if it is, it goes live on your domain.

Every site is custom and mobile-first. From the Basic plan up, the search foundations are in place from the start: clean structure, fast pages, structured data, and content that lives in the page source so AI crawlers can read it rather than seeing an empty page. The one-page Landing plan is design only, with no search work, and the pricing page says so plainly.

What is included

Hosting and website maintenance are part of every plan, so there is no separate IT bill and no invoice when your hours change or you want a new photo up. The tiers and what each one covers are on the pricing page.
